title: NoFunZone
tagline: A decentralized game platform designed to educate non-blockchain users about web3
description:
Non-blockchain users closer to the web3 world. Our goal is to make the process of onboarding non-blockchain users a fun and enjoyable experience. Through user-friendly UX/UI and gamified educational modules, users can easily comprehend and interact with the technology behind web3.

The No fun zone leverages state-of-the-art technology such as FileCoin and LivePeer. FileCoin is a decentralized data storage network that offers secure, fast, and cost-effective video content storage, ensuring users have a smooth learning experience. LivePeer, on the other hand, is a decentralized video infrastructure platform that provides scalable and efficient video transcoding, distribution, and storage. This enables us to store and distribute large amounts of video content quickly and efficiently.

Moreover, the No Fun Zone features a distinctive NFT collection that can be accessed across multiple chains. This allows users to innovatively enhance their learning experience and interact with web3 technology.

how_its_made: The project was developed using a combination of technologies, including Alchemy's NFT SDK, Filecoin node, and NFT.stoage for the NFTs. The NFTs were designed using Illustrator, Photoshop, and Procreate, while the front end was designed using Figma. Anima was used to convert Figma visuals into code and integrate the back end.
